description: A note in a Shared Computer Network workspace space: markdown for any atproto reader, an Automerge document for SCN clients to merge.

noteId.description: Stable identity for the note. The same value in every author's copy and on every device. Generated once at creation, never changed.

path.description: Path of the note within the workspace, ending in .md, e.g. 'Projects/Scene note draft.md'. Unique per workspace and per author.

title.description: Display title. Derived on every write from frontmatter title, else the first H1, else the filename.

body.description: The note's text. Obsidian Flavored Markdown until markpub adds an 'ofm' flavor; see extensions and renderingRules.

updatedAt.description: When this snapshot was written. Records are replaced in place, so this is the only recency signal.

docId.description: Automerge document id (UUID). Present when the author's copy has a CRDT document.

automerge.description: The Automerge document at 'heads'. Opaque to readers who are not SCN clients.

heads.description: Automerge heads this snapshot represents. Lets a client see whether its local document is ahead, behind, or diverged without fetching the blob.

textHash.description: SHA-256 of the markdown bytes, hex. Cheap equality check between a local .md file and this snapshot.

tags.description: Projection of frontmatter tags and inline #tags for browsing. Not the source of truth; the body is.

status.description: Absent means live. 'deleted' is a tombstone so an offline device cannot resurrect the note; it does not erase the record or the CRDT.

blobs.description: Images the body references, listed so they stay alive in the author's PDS.

scene.description: The space this note belongs to: at://{authority}/space/{spaceType}/{skey}. Redundant with the record URI, useful when a record travels.
